vocab.def: bright light and warmth from the sun
a white or gray shape in the sky made of water vapor
soft white pieces of ice that fall from the sky
very bad weather with strong wind, rain, thunder, or lightning
the loud noise in the sky during a storm
a flash of electricity in the sky during a storm
when too much water covers land or streets
a long time with little or no rain
a storm with a lot of snow and strong wind
a coat that keeps you dry in the rain
an object you hold over your head to stay dry in rain
rain that falls very hard and in large amounts

sentences.text: The children played in the sunshine at the beach.
sentences.l1: Bọn trẻ chơi dưới ánh nắng ở bãi biển.

sentences.text: There are no clouds, so there will be sunshine today.
sentences.l1: Không có mây, nên hôm nay sẽ có nắng.

sentences.text: Suddenly, there were a lot of clouds in the sky.
sentences.l1: Đột nhiên có rất nhiều mây trên trời.

sentences.text: Look at those dark clouds; it might rain.
sentences.l1: Nhìn những đám mây đen kia; trời có thể mưa.

sentences.text: It might rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
sentences.l1: Ngày mai có thể mưa, nên hãy mang ô.

sentences.text: It will rain today, so we need raincoats.
sentences.l1: Hôm nay trời sẽ mưa, nên chúng ta cần áo mưa.

sentences.text: It might snow later, so wear your winter coat.
sentences.l1: Lát nữa có thể có tuyết, nên hãy mặc áo khoác mùa đông.

sentences.text: It is very cold, so it could snow today.
sentences.l1: Trời rất lạnh, nên hôm nay có thể có tuyết.

sentences.text: It is storming, so there will be thunder and lightning.
sentences.l1: Trời đang bão, nên sẽ có sấm và sét.

sentences.text: The storm made the beach cold and dark.
sentences.l1: Cơn bão làm bãi biển lạnh và tối.

sentences.text: What is that noise? It might be thunder.
sentences.l1: Tiếng gì vậy? Có thể là sấm.

sentences.text: There will be thunder during the storm.
sentences.l1: Sẽ có sấm trong cơn bão.

sentences.text: Look at that lightning! It might rain soon.
sentences.l1: Nhìn tia sét kia! Trời có thể sắp mưa.

sentences.text: There was thunder and lightning at the beach.
sentences.l1: Có sấm và sét ở bãi biển.

sentences.text: It is raining a lot, so there might be a flood.
sentences.l1: Trời mưa rất nhiều, nên có thể có lũ.

sentences.text: If it rains heavily all night, there could be a flood.
sentences.l1: Nếu mưa lớn cả đêm, có thể có lũ.

sentences.text: If it does not rain for months, there will be a drought.
sentences.l1: Nếu nhiều tháng không mưa, sẽ có hạn hán.

sentences.text: The farmers were worried because there was a drought.
sentences.l1: Nông dân lo lắng vì có hạn hán.

sentences.text: It is very cold and cloudy, so there could be a snowstorm.
sentences.l1: Trời rất lạnh và nhiều mây, nên có thể có bão tuyết.

sentences.text: There might be a snowstorm in the mountains tonight.
sentences.l1: Tối nay có thể có bão tuyết trên núi.

sentences.text: Shall we wear raincoats today?
sentences.l1: Hôm nay chúng ta mặc áo mưa nhé?

sentences.text: The truck driver gave the children a big raincoat.
sentences.l1: Người lái xe tải đưa cho bọn trẻ một chiếc áo mưa lớn.

sentences.text: We should find an umbrella before it rains.
sentences.l1: Chúng ta nên tìm một cái ô trước khi trời mưa.

sentences.text: Shall we take an umbrella to the park?
sentences.l1: Chúng ta mang ô đến công viên nhé?

sentences.text: It might rain, but I do not think it will.
sentences.l1: Trời có thể mưa, nhưng tôi không nghĩ là sẽ mưa.

sentences.text: I think the rain will be heavy.
sentences.l1: Tôi nghĩ mưa sẽ lớn.

sentences.text: Shall we go home?
sentences.l1: Chúng ta về nhà nhé?

sentences.text: We should go home because it is cold now.
sentences.l1: Chúng ta nên về nhà vì bây giờ trời lạnh.

repair.broken: It might rains tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.

errors.explanation: After might, use the base verb.

a: It might rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.

repair.broken: It is raining a lot, so there might a flood.
a: It is raining a lot, so there might be a flood.

repair.broken: If it does not rain for months, there be a drought.

errors.explanation: Use will for a strong future prediction.

a: If it does not rain for months, there will be a drought.

repair.broken: We should to find an umbrella before it rains.

errors.explanation: Use should + base verb, not should to.

a: We should find an umbrella before it rains.

repair.broken: We should go home because it cold now.
a: We should go home because it is cold now.

transform.prompt: Complete with may, might, or could.
transform.broken: It is raining a lot. There ___ be a flood.
a: It is raining a lot. There might be a flood.
It is raining a lot. There may be a flood.
It is raining a lot. There could be a flood.
transform.explanation: Use may, might, or could for future possibility.

transform.broken: It is storming. There ___ be thunder and lightning.
a: It is storming. There will be thunder and lightning.
transform.explanation: Use will for a strong prediction.

transform.prompt: Make a suggestion with Shall we.
transform.explanation: Use Shall we + base verb for a suggestion.

transform.broken: It might rain. take an umbrella
transform.explanation: Use should + base verb to give advice.
